purpose: Audit which quantities are preserved and which are transformed under the candidate projection witness from the Core Expression into an existing RT expression.

invariants.reading: The projection witness leaves RT_core unchanged.
The Core Expression is typed into projection_regime_xb before candidate projection.
The projection is structured by domain, scale, and admissibility.
RT closure is preserved only for the witness if the candidate closes under the governing RT condition.
Residue records the projection history rather than a claim of identity.
Projection changes orientation by rebinding the Core Expression into the receiving witness context.
Identity between the Core Expression and the governed RT witness is not assumed.
The projection is not treated as invertible by default.

preserved: verified RT closure in the witness, if the candidate closes

non_claims: Does not assert all RTs are projections.
Does not assert different projections must yield the same RT.
Does not assert projection removes residue.
